decomp: recover 195 functions and highlight A2DE 4.032326%

Recover 62 object layouts, shared model bases and Platform list/geometry
routines. Add 24,284 matching code bytes with all 1,223 previous matching
functions retained. Totals: 115,988 / 2,876,454 bytes; 1,418 / 15,667
functions. All measurement denominators are unchanged.

Locally verify all 195 functions against complete normalized ARM
instructions and exact relocation types/names/addends. Reproduce their
aggregate code/reference fingerprint in CI after compiling all 358 units.
Pass 4,000 existing synthetic tests plus 4,000 platform operations and
12 resets.

Show this fork's measured percentage prominently in README and a local
SVG generated from integer totals, with a CI consistency check. Record
the 8-byte data-accounting correction at Object325's table boundary.
No ROM or original game data is published; no playable-ROM claim.
